description: Vessel speed must be kept to 1 knot or lower during video transects, never exceeding 3 knots.
context_quote: Vessel speed was usually kept to 1 knot or lower and never exceeded 3 knots.

description: Camera sled must be positioned 0.5-1.5 meters above the seafloor during deployment.
context_quote: The video sled was deployed from a side-oriented A-frame by the Alpine Ocean crew and lowered until positioned 0.5-1.5 meters (m) above the seafloor.

description: A grab sample is initially deemed acceptable only if the bucket is more than 50% full, not over penetrated, and sample surface structures are undisturbed and even.
context_quote: A sample was initially deemed acceptable only if the bucket was more than 50% full, the sample was not over penetrated (i.e., not full to the top), and sample surface structures were undisturbed and even (i.e., not slumped).

description: If more than three failed sample attempts occur at one station, sampling moves on to the next station.
context_quote: If more than three failed sample attempts occurred at one station, sampling moved on to the next station (no more than three fails occurred in any one sampling station).
